Claude Code, Oct 28-29, session 3. The lease is still held by Claude, which is still working. This is a pointer, not proof: verify against the files and Git.
1. New CI gate: tools/evidence_audit.py (job 'Evidence audit'). It checks every SHA-256 claim in evidence manifests, source freezes, launch-source lists and each launch plan's runtime_source (27,117 claims) against committed blobs, using the audited revision's own history. Before committing a new archive, run: python tools/evidence_audit.py --worktree
2. What now fails CI: an archive file listed in a manifest but not committed; a freeze naming a version no commit holds; a claim file that is emptied, reformatted, deleted or renamed. Fix the evidence, or classify the case in evidence/2026-10-28/evidence-integrity-01/make_exceptions.py and regenerate tools/evidence_exceptions.json. Do not hand-edit the JSON.
3. Recurring cause: tests/test_module_latency_gates.py has one CRLF line in the Windows working copy, so every freeze binds a version no commit holds (20 rebuild exceptions so far). Normalizing that file's line endings and committing it would stop new ones. It is frozen source, so do that only when you decide it is safe for campaign14.
4. Restored: 532 never-copied archive files (byte-exact, from each manifest's own run under logs/). No manifest was edited. Full account: evidence/2026-10-28/evidence-integrity-01/README.md.
5. Board: tested bitstreams are archived in evidence/2026-10-28/basys3-bitstreams-01. python -m hwsuite program|hw --design X --bit FILE reran all six winners from them, and every result reproduced exactly (basys3-bitstream-replay-01).

Claude Code, Oct 29. The user gave Claude full authority over the repo, including running the harness. Claude still holds the lease. This is a pointer, not proof: verify against the files and Git.
1. A harness build is running on the Basys 3. run.py build on hardware/basys3/harness_built/uart_tx/design_spec.json generated a UART TX: 34 to 22 LUTs, timing met, 14 calls, 9.4 min (logs/harness-uart-tx-03, archived in evidence/2026-10-29/harness-uart-tx-01). The unedited winner drives the board's TX pin and echoed 100,000 of 100,000 bytes. Pushed in 3f507f8; CI is green.
2. Four harness gaps it exposed are in docs/TASKS.md (October29 section). The serious one is stale_child_masks_flattened_winner: the optimizer flattened away uart_tx_core, but candidates were still compiled beside the baseline child file, so an integration testbench naming the child tested the baseline child. Claude plans to fix this in the harness, with a taxonomy entry first and tests, then run the tier0 gate. This changes frozen source, so campaign14 must be launched on the new identity afterwards.
3. Never tail run files on Windows. A tail -F on events.jsonl crashed run 02 (WinError 5 on atomic replace); resume recovered it.
4. Board timing note: the harness's 100 MHz slack is mostly pad delay, not logic. The Fmax sweep (hardware/basys3/fmax) is running.
subject: Harness-built UART TX runs on the Basys 3; four harness gaps recorded
